title: Rise of the Runelords
blurb: A goblin raid on the sleepy coastal town of Sandpoint unravels into the return of Karzoug, Runelord of Greed — and a reckoning seven thousand years in the making.

roster.name: Cassia — Human Fighter
roster.bio: A former prison guard with quick hands and a lockpick's curiosity, picked up from watching — and studying — the inmates in her charge. Warm and personable, and always happy to show off a trick for someone she trusts.

roster.name: Essoren — Human Sorcerer
roster.bio: Raised outside Wartle along the Yondabakri River; his fair Chelaxian complexion traces back to ancestors who fled generations of changeling blood. His curses have a habit of striking back at whoever draws first blood.
